collection_scope: Russia-only navigation snapshot (issue #316). Covers Moscow, Saint Petersburg, Yekaterinburg, Kazan with verified group/slot rows; Novosibirsk, Kirov (two same-named localities), Vladivostok as official region-directory fallback only; plus three online groups from the national online catalog. Remaining Russian regions are not imported in v1; the national root catalog URL is the fallback. Website reports 1303 registered groups as of August 2026; that number is not an import quota and is not claimed here.
freshness_policy: Weekly non-destructive source check; 30-day freshness review threshold for detailed times/addresses (configurable). Stale schedules are served as official-link navigation with an unconfirmed-schedule caveat, never as exact today/tomorrow claims. Even fresh published times are not live availability.
gaps: Regions beyond the eight listed regional pointers have no v1 rows; use the root catalog URL.
Novosibirsk, both Kirov localities and Vladivostok have directory links only, no verified group rows.
Online group Vecherniy has an unparsed/unknown schedule and unknown timezone: navigation only.
Kazan Idel schedule_verified_at is 2026-07-01 and is served as stale navigation, not exact occurrences.
No phone numbers, entry codes, personal identities, or transient join links are stored by policy.

omission_reasons.bulk_group_import: Bulk republication rights unconfirmed (robots/terms unknown); v1 keeps minimal manually reviewed pointers plus official links.
omission_reasons.contacts_and_codes: Privacy gate: contacts, intercom/access codes and personal data are never stored.
omission_reasons.external_region_sites: External regional sites need a per-source adapter, permission check and health tracking before deep import.
